title: javascript: URLs are refused in app modules
intent: A javascript: href executes script on click — an XSS vector that survives the framework's attribute escaping. Links carry http(s), mailto, tel or in-app router paths only.

runtime.rationale: The refusal is of authoring javascript: URLs in source. Data-driven links are the sanctioned components' own concern (the Markdown component strips unsafe protocols at render -- its control, not this rule's), and raw anchors are refused wholesale in app modules anyway.
